Mathematics BSc at University of Bristol

What University of Bristol asks of applicants to Mathematics BSc for 2027 entry (the 2026–27 application cycle). Each requirement below is labelled verified, partly verified or not verified, with the date it was checked and a link to the official source.

UK · All University of Bristol courses · Mathematics field guide

Entry requirements 2027 entry 5 of 8 verified
SAT / ACT
  • For applicants with a US high-school diploma: SAT/ACT is not generally required — Bristol does not generally require standardised tests (Law requires LNAT; Medicine requires UCAT)
  • SAT (evidence-based reading and writing section only) at 650+ or ACT at 28+ may count as one of the three additional qualifications needed alongside the diploma (GPA 3.2 minimum, 3.4 for competitive courses)
Verified19 Oct 2026Bristol: USA – entry requirements
English language
  • Bristol English language Profile E
  • IELTS 6.5 overall with 6.0 in all skills
  • TOEFL iBT:
    • 88 overall with R20 L19 S22 W22 (tests up to 20 Jan 2026)
    • 4.5 overall with 4.5 in all skills (tests from 21 Jan 2026)
  • Pearson PTE Academic 67 overall with no lower than 64 in all skills
  • GCSE English Language grade C/4 also accepted

Required if English is not the applicant’s first language.

Verified19 Oct 2026Bristol: BSc Mathematics (2027 entry) · Bristol: English language Profile E
Admissions tests
  • STEP — optional; STEP paper achievement may be included as part of an alternative offer

Bristol does not publish the STEP-based alternative offer on the course page or in the 2027 Admissions Statement.

Verified19 Oct 2026Bristol: BSc Mathematics (2027 entry)
Subject prerequisites
  • Required: Mathematics (A* at A level; 7 at HL in IB, either course)
  • Official also requires a second mathematics-related subject (Biology, Chemistry, Computer Science, Economics or Physics) or Further Mathematics on the A*AA route — not held by the engine

Official (2027 entry): Mathematics plus A in another mathematics-related subject (Biology, Chemistry, Computer Science, Economics or Physics), or Mathematics and Further Mathematics on the A*AA route. The Admissions Statement also says preference will be given to applicants studying Biology, Chemistry, Computer Science, Computing, Engineering, IT, Further Mathematics, Physics or Psychology.

Partly verified19 Oct 2026Bristol: BSc Mathematics (2027 entry) · Bristol: Admissions Statement 2027 – Mathematics
A-Level requirements
Grades
A*A*A
Required subjects
Mathematics
Details
A*A*A including A* in Mathematics and A in another mathematics-related subject (Biology, Chemistry, Computer Science, Economics or Physics), or A*AA including A*A (in any order) in Mathematics and Further Mathematics. STEP paper achievement may be included as part of an alternative offer.
Contextual offer
AAA including Mathematics and another mathematics-related subject, or AAB including AA in Mathematics and Further Mathematics, for eligible contextual applicants

Official (2027 entry): A*A*A including A* in Mathematics and A in another mathematics-related subject, or A*AA including A*A (in any order) in Mathematics and Further Mathematics. The A*A*A offer agrees; the second-subject requirement is not held by the engine.

IB requirements
Overall score
40 points
Required subjects
Mathematics
Higher Level
Mathematics (Analysis and Approaches or Applications and Interpretations)
Details
40 with 18 at HL, incl 7 in HL Mathematics — Analysis & Approaches OR Applications & Interpretation both accepted (many competitive maths courses take only AA) — and 6 at HL in another mathematics-related subject (Biology, Chemistry, Computer Science, Economics or Physics)

Contextual offer: 36 points with 18 at HL including 6, 6 at HL in Mathematics and another mathematics-related subject. STEP may form part of an alternative offer.

Verified19 Oct 2026Bristol: BSc Mathematics (2027 entry)
Other qualifications
  • Advanced Placement:
    • 3 AP exams at grades 4, 4, 4
    • Minimum GPA 3.2
  • Official: US high-school diploma with GPA 3.2 minimum (3.4 for competitive courses) plus three additional qualifications — AP tests at 4 or above (more commonly 5), AP classes over two semesters, Honors classes, dual-enrolment courses, SAT/ACT, IB Higher Level courses or A levels
  • Courses asking for maths: AP Calculus BC at grade 5 is required

Official (2027 entry): high-school diploma with GPA 3.2 minimum (3.4 for competitive courses) and three additional qualifications; AP tests count at a score of at least 4 (more commonly 5). Bristol does not say which courses count as competitive, and APs are one of several qualification types that can make up the three.

Partly verified19 Oct 2026Bristol: USA – entry requirements
Other requirements
  • Applications are scored and ranked on academic record: GCSE 20%, A-level (or equivalent) 80%
  • Personal statement and reference are not normally considered — used only to separate applicants with the same academic score
  • Not routinely interviewed (interviews only in exceptional circumstances)
  • Applicants without A-level Mathematics (e.g. BTEC or Access) may be invited to take an additional mathematics assessment
Verified19 Oct 2026Bristol: Admissions Statement 2027 – Mathematics
